description: This file implements the DataElementFile class, which manages file-backed memory mapping, including opening, closing, reallocating, and synchronizing memory-mapped files across different platforms (Windows and POSIX).

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: A class that manages file-based memory mapping, supporting platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.description: Constructor initializing with a File object and type flags.

methods.description: Constructor initializing with filename, type flags, and requested size.

methods.description: Loads the file and maps it into memory if not already open.

methods.description: Platform-specific method to open and map the file into memory.
